blind.description: A stylized antique wooden sideboard or credenza in warm reddish-brown wood. It features six carved legs with gold caps, two side cabinets with doors swung open to reveal interior shelving, a central section with two curved faux or real drawers, and a raised top surface edged along the back with a brass gallery rail.
blind.from_above: A rounded rectangular tabletop with a gentle bow front and a brass railing running along the rear edge, with the edges of two opened cabinet doors jutting forward from the front corners.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 40-45% as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2.5 ft tall) and roughly as wide as the figure is tall (about 5.5 to 6 ft wide).
